title: Malmgren investigates for Kennedy administration, visits Lawrence Gise of the AEC
place_text: Albuquerque / Sandia National Laboratories, New Mexico

tellings.quote:
so he then as a result of that goes and
visits Loris Lawrence G or Geese um
who's Jeff Bezos's maternal grandfather
and the Albuquerque director of the
atomic energy commission

plain: In 1962 a man named Harold Malmgren, looking into the matter for the Kennedy administration, went to Albuquerque, New Mexico, to see Lawrence Preston Gise, the Albuquerque director of the Atomic Energy Commission, the federal agency then in charge of US nuclear work, and, as Michels points out, Jeff Bezos's maternal grandfather. Michels tells this himself, without naming a source, in an episode with the Senate staffer Kirk McConnell; it would place the UFO question inside the nuclear establishment during Kennedy's time.
